name: eye-on-cursor
description:
Add animated eyes to your GNOME panel that follow your mouse cursor. Bring your desktop to life!

Comes with a cursor tracker to help you keep track of your pointer during presentations, screencasts, or everyday use.

Features:
- Panel eyes that follow your mouse cursor
- Eye shape, color, and blinking customization
- Customizable cursor tracker with keyboard shortcut

Forked from Eye and Mouse Extended by Alexey Lovchikov.
author: Djinn Alexio
